# Which files does Kilo Code read?

Rulegate adapter id: `kilo` · Verified against Kilo 1.0.25 (source, main branch) on 2026-09-26 · [Homepage](https://kilo.ai)

Every file below that is present is **sent to the model**, all together. The order ranks specificity rather than authority — nothing here overrides anything else.

## Precedence

| # | Path | Scope | Role | Rulegate writes it | Nesting |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `.kilocode/rules/*.md` | project | instructions | yes | root only |
| 2 | `.kilocoderules` | project | instructions | no | root only |
| 3 | `.kilocoderules-*` | project | instructions | no | root only |
| 4 | `.kilocode/rules-*/*.md` | project | instructions | no | root only |
| 5 | `.kilo/kilo.jsonc` | project | settings | no | root only |
| 6 | `.kilo/kilo.json` | project | settings | no | root only |
| 7 | `kilo.json` | project | settings | no | root only |
| 8 | `kilo.jsonc` | project | settings | no | root only |
| 9 | `opencode.json` | project | settings | no | root only |
| 10 | `AGENTS.md` | project | instructions | no | all-merged |
| 11 | `~/.config/kilo/kilo.jsonc` | user-level | settings | no | root only |
| 12 | `~/.kilocode/rules/*.md` | user-level | instructions | no | root only |

## What each file is

### `.kilocode/rules/*.md`

The legacy rules directory, auto-loaded for backward compatibility: only the immediate .md children, in directory-listing order. This is what Rulegate generates, because it is the one Kilo path that loads without an entry in a config file.

Source: [Kilo Code — Custom rules](https://kilo.ai/docs/customize/custom-rules) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `.kilocoderules`

The legacy single-file rules at the project root, still auto-loaded. Rulegate imports it and never writes it.

Source: [Kilo source — Kilocode rules migration](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilo/blob/main/packages/opencode/src/kilocode/docs/rules-migration.md) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `.kilocoderules-*`

Mode-specific legacy single files (.kilocoderules-code and the like). Like the mode directories, Kilo loads them in every mode. Rulegate imports them as ordinary rules and never writes them.

Source: [Kilo source — Kilocode rules migration](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilo/blob/main/packages/opencode/src/kilocode/docs/rules-migration.md) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `.kilocode/rules-*/*.md`

Mode-specific rule directories (code, architect, ask, debug, orchestrator). Kilo loads them in every mode, not only their own. Rulegate imports them as ordinary rules and never writes them.

Source: [Kilo source — Kilocode rules migration](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilo/blob/main/packages/opencode/src/kilocode/docs/rules-migration.md) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `.kilo/kilo.jsonc`

The project config, preferred over a root kilo.jsonc. Its instructions entries are the current way to load rules, including anything in .kilo/rules/, which is not auto-loaded. Kilo's Settings UI writes this file, so Rulegate imports its local instructions and never writes it.

Source: [Kilo Code — Settings and config files](https://kilo.ai/docs/getting-started/settings) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `.kilo/kilo.json`

The JSON spelling of the project config under .kilo/. Imported like .kilo/kilo.jsonc, never written.

Source: [Kilo Code — Settings and config files](https://kilo.ai/docs/getting-started/settings) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `kilo.json`

The JSON spelling of the root project config, deep-merged with kilo.jsonc. Imported, never written.

Source: [Kilo Code — Settings and config files](https://kilo.ai/docs/getting-started/settings) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `kilo.jsonc`

The project config at the root, deep-merged with kilo.json and the legacy opencode.json. Imported, never written.

Source: [Kilo Code — Settings and config files](https://kilo.ai/docs/getting-started/settings) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `opencode.json`

OpenCode's project config, which Kilo still deep-merges. The opencode adapter imports it, so this one does not. Kilo does not read .opencode/, so the opencode adapter's output never reaches Kilo.

Source: [Kilo Code — Settings and config files](https://kilo.ai/docs/getting-started/settings) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `AGENTS.md`

Loaded at the root when a task starts (AGENT.md is the fallback spelling); a per-directory copy is loaded when the agent reads a file in that directory. Generated by the codex adapter, not by this one — so enabling kilo and codex together sends Kilo the same rules twice.

Source: [Kilo Code — AGENTS.md](https://kilo.ai/docs/customize/agents-md) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `~/.config/kilo/kilo.jsonc`

The global config. Its instructions load before the project ones, which take precedence. Reported, never written.

Source: [Kilo Code — Settings and config files](https://kilo.ai/docs/getting-started/settings) — retrieved 2026-09-26

### `~/.kilocode/rules/*.md`

The legacy global rules directory, still auto-loaded. Outside the repository, so Rulegate reports it and never writes it.

Source: [Kilo source — Kilocode rules migration](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilo/blob/main/packages/opencode/src/kilocode/docs/rules-migration.md) — retrieved 2026-09-26

## Size limits

Kilo documents no size cap on rule files or AGENTS.md.

## Notes

- **warn** — Rulegate writes .kilocode/rules/, which Kilo documents as legacy and loads only for backward compatibility; its docs recommend moving rules into kilo.jsonc instructions. Rulegate cannot follow that advice without owning kilo.jsonc, which Kilo's own Settings UI edits. If Kilo drops the legacy loader, the generated rules stop loading and nothing reports it.
  Source: [Kilo Code — Custom rules](https://kilo.ai/docs/customize/custom-rules) — retrieved 2026-09-26
- **info** — Kilo loads .kilocode/rules/ in directory-listing order, which it does not sort. Generated files carry a zero-padded position prefix so that a sorted listing matches canonical order; on a filesystem that lists in another order, the rules still all load, possibly in a different sequence.
  Source: [Kilo source — Kilocode rules migration](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilo/blob/main/packages/opencode/src/kilocode/docs/rules-migration.md) — retrieved 2026-09-26
- **info** — Kilo's pages disagree about CLAUDE.md: the AGENTS.md page names only AGENTS.md and AGENT.md, while the rules-migration notes say CLAUDE.md is loaded natively, as OpenCode does. It is left out of this list until one of them is confirmed.
  Source: [Kilo Code — AGENTS.md](https://kilo.ai/docs/customize/agents-md) — retrieved 2026-09-26
- **info** — Import skips remote URLs, home-directory and absolute paths in instructions, and anything under .agent-os/, .ruler/, .rulesync/ or .rulegate/ or at a file another adapter imports (AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules/*.mdc, .github/copilot-instructions.md and the like — matched by the patterns that adapter reads, so .claude/docs/ is still imported), each with a warning. Remote instructions are fetched by Kilo itself; Rulegate never fetches them.
  Source: [Kilo Code — Settings and config files](https://kilo.ai/docs/getting-started/settings) — retrieved 2026-09-26
